changes: Slime source IDs share the existing nativeElementFor mapping. All seven elemental variants and corresponding large forms are immune only to their own damage element.

Elemental-body immunity is enforced on final applyDamage packets, including reaction, DOT, field, object and summon damage. Slime damage and aura dispatch retain native reaction generation: Spread and Aggravate still occur while the additive own-element damage is zero.

Three existing Abyss Mage shield source IDs block own-element damage; Cryo shield also blocks Hydro. Active-shield preflight prevents an immune packet from reducing a stacked barrier or overflowing into body HP.
Mage shield protection does not become body immunity: Hydro application and subsequent Frozen reaction remain possible, and the exposed body takes its own element after the barrier breaks.
Existing saved shields use their original source/value without migration. Zero authored shield multipliers no longer silently become one.
The Andrius pre-hit immunity exit is bypassed only for native slimes. All existing boss immunity and control rules remain in their prior chain.

nativeSlimeCoverage.notes: The large Dendro slime has no native encounter member; source-rule verification is static only.

verification.fixtureScope: Enemy actors and stats are native authored/generated spawns. Companion recruitment/party assignment uses native admin/party operations. AI held at opening and RNG 60/0.5 isolate packet behavior; this is not a balance/time measurement. Explicit large packets and one stacked test shield isolate overflow math. Native legal cards verify direct damage, reaction generation, fields and a summon.

coordination.controlFixture: Control owner replaced the existing C05 Cryo-slime expectation with a Cryo-afflicted non-immune native archer. Self-turn/contact/restore/guard expectations are preserved; this agent did not edit that file.

limitations: No ordinary-enemy elemental resistance, large Cryo/Geo slime armor, Cryo Cicin shield or currently unsupported Electro Mage shield design was added.
No HP/ATK, encounter groups, rewards, UI, DB, or persistent shield values changed.
Body immunity now participates in pre-existing immunity-aware control checks; no extra control-immunity rule was introduced.
The full release validation and publishing remain the root agent responsibility.

followUpTutorialHttpRegression.verified: Current native+HTTP guided combat4inputs victory; basic-only28inputs victory versus baseline9. Existing20cap retained; all four actual lesson completions now asserted.
